 Home » Southern States »  Telangana Major Fire Accident In High-rise Apartment At Nanakramguda
 Telangana DC Web Desk 19 Nov 2026 2:26 PM IST 19 Nov 2026 2:26 PM IST A major fire broke out near one of the blocks at Pacifica Hill Crest apartment complex in Nankramguda, triggering panic among residents.
 x Screengrab from Video As Preferred
Source Hyderabad: A major fire broke out near one of the blocks at the Pacifica Hill Crest apartment complex in Nanakramguda, in Puppalaguda near the Financial District in Hyderabad, on Thursday afternoon, triggering panic among residents. 
 Four fire engines and emergency personnel from Gachibowli have rushed to the spot after receiving information to put out the fire in the 22-storey building in one of the blocks. The fire is said to have spread to the upper floors of the building, as per the visuals, which appeared to have started from the fifth floor. 
 The apartment has around five blocks in each phase, with road setbacks between each block, and as per the latest news, the fire engines have reached the spot. Residents of the apartment rushed out of the building as the fire spread rapidly across the building. 
 The cause of the fire, the extent of property damage, and details of any injuries are yet to be confirmed. Further details are awaited...
